decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of its depth, scale and siting along the shared boundaries with Nos. 47 and 51 Poynter Road, would result in an overly dominant and overbearing form of development causing an unacceptable loss of outlook, increased sense of enclosure and harmful reductions in daylight and sunlight to adjoining occupiers. Accordingly, the proposal would fail the neighbour amenity test contained within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A and A.4 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) and would be contrary to Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policy DMD11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Single storey rear extension 6m deep x 3m high (3m high to eaves) and single storey infill extension 5.55m deep x 3m high (3m high to eaves).
